data.body: Consideration: [Reliability] If the deliberate-violation PR is NOT blocked by CI (false-negative), the violation pattern must be benign enough to merge safely OR the PR must auto-close on detection. Define the rollback: (a) violation pattern is a no-op marker file or comment-only change with a detectable bad pattern, (b) if `gh pr checks` shows green when block was expected, immediately revert enforcement.strategy to local in a follow-up commit and file a P0 bug, (c) document the expected check name(s) that must show FAILURE — not just absence of green.
